theorems.name: Submission.whitney_gluing_hasFDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (ν : Rn n → Rn n) (ι : Type) (φ : ι → Rn n → ℝ) (p : ι → Rn n) (C : ℝ) (g : Rn n → ℝ), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn ν A → (∀ K ⊆ A, IsCompact K → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ A, 0 < ‖y - x‖ → ‖y - x‖ < δ → |h y - h x - inner ℝ (ν x) (y - x)| ≤ ε * ‖y - x‖) → 0 ≤ C → (∀ i, p i ∈ A) → (∀ x ∈ A, g x = h x) → (∀ x ∉ A, ∃ S : Finset ι, (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ φ i x ∧ ‖x - p i‖ ≤ C * Metric.infDist x A) ∧ ∑ i ∈ S, φ i x = 1 ∧ g x = ∑ i ∈ S, φ i x * (h (p i) + inner ℝ (ν (p i)) (x - p i))) → ∀ a ∈ A, HasFDerivAt g (innerSL ℝ (ν a)) a
